notes: Runnable: with deepseek-flash for every role, a readiness smoke completes two accepted dev rounds and hidden test_001 Result 30 (scoreable, valid, publishable), independent review 10/10, gate READY with source_unchanged; the release-provenance formal gate dry run passes. A submission whose own lower codex closes its connection mid-response is an infrastructure attempt and is not consumed (the broker request completes; no failed receipt is written). One unattributed provider-failure receipt makes a readiness smoke inadmissible; the release's Codex exporter attributes that case.

Environment: cargo-home comes from the sha-pinned archive when AGENTSWE_ENV_ARCHIVE_DIR holds it (about 20 s), otherwise by recipe: cargo fetch --locked of the a0 Cargo.lock from crates.io (resumable retries) plus the sha256-pinned rusty_v8 v150.4.0 asset; crates.io can be slow (about 19 min on one host; AGENTSWE_BUILD_PROXY is honoured). With either path the evaluator's offline baseline build of the unchanged a0 compiles (cargo 1.95.0). The crate cache (1,155 files) and the 6 git checkouts equal the paper environment byte for byte; rusty_v8 differs only in compression (the paper's .gz was recompressed; the library is identical).

Release change (2026-10-10): Docker 29 removes an exited or stopped --rm container asynchronously: for several seconds `docker inspect` still shows it and `docker rm -f` answers "removal of container ... is already in progress" (exit 1); Docker 24 has removed it by then. evaluator/harness/run_lower_agent_case.py cleanup_lower_container (after a deadline or transport-failure kill of the --rm lower container, absent_after_cleanup false made the case an evaluator_infrastructure_failure; the wait stays inside the case's 30 s evidence reserve) and harbor/formal_one_stop.py cleanup_broker record rm's stderr and, when rm answers "already in progress", wait up to 30 s for the container to be gone before deciding absence. Any other rm refusal is judged as before, and a container still present after the wait is not absent. Seen with Docker 29.2.1.
